svg.aria-label: Packages that import gridax: diagnostix in GeoNumerics, which uses the collocated grids, difference and gradient; xrtoolz-ops in GeoStack, which uses the collocated grids, divergence and the strains; and in GeoModels sesmax-core, which uses CField, GridOps, the masks and the solvers, sesmax-ocean, which uses GridOps, CField, fill_ghosts and area_sum, and plumax, which uses BC, advect, diffuse and the vertical terms. xrtoolz-ops and plumax also build on diagnostix, and sesmax-ocean on sesmax-core. gridax builds on NumPy, SciPy, jaxtyping, geophysix and pipekit-array; its jax extra adds JAX, equinox, lineax, gaussx and spectraldiffx, and its pipekit extra pipekit-jax and integrix.
svg.title: gridax and the packages that import it
